categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in intelligent manufacturing and smart logistics, offering integrated solutions including intelligent production systems, intelligent logistics warehousing systems, and intelligent automated parking systems. These segments cover planning consulting, software development, intelligent equipment design and manufacturing, system integration, installation, and after-sales services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include IoT-based real-time data acquisition and edge computing, AI-driven scheduling and control systems, digital twin platforms using Unity3D engine, multi-level S-curve motion control, and advanced robotics such as AGV with laser SLAM and vision navigation. Production methods emphasize customized, large-scale, non-standard equipment manufacturing with modular design, supported by in-house software and hardware development capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span automotive manufacturers (including Mercedes-Benz, Audi, BMW, BYD), new energy battery producers (CATL, Envision Power), steel and metallurgy companies (Baowu Steel), pharmaceutical firms (Sinopharm, CR Pharma), consumer goods, e-commerce, cold chain logistics, and petrochemical industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including Southeast Asia, North America, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and projects are concentrated in China with production bases in Shanxi, Jiangsu, and Shanghai. The company has expanded internationally with subsidiaries and projects in Malaysia, the US, Germany, the UK, Australia, Poland, Russia, Japan, Thailand, Iran, and Iraq, focusing on Southeast Asia, North America, and Europe for overseas market growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated intelligent manufacturing and logistics solutions including equipment manufacturing, software systems, and turnkey project delivery. It acts as a system integrator and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating domestic market leadership, accelerating international expansion, and deepening technology innovation. R&D focuses on intelligent hardware, AI, industrial internet, digital twin technology, 5G-enabled smart warehousing, and green low-carbon logistics solutions. The company collaborates with academic institutions and industry leaders to advance core technologies and expand product portfolios.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of intelligent production systems, logistics warehousing systems, and automated parking systems, including customized equipment and software solutions. The company follows a contract-based model with milestone payments including prepayments, delivery payments, final acceptance payments, and warranty retention. It also earns from after-sales services and spare parts sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic intelligent logistics equipment supplier with strong system integration capabilities and international delivery experience. It competes in sectors such as automotive manufacturing, new energy, steel, pharmaceuticals, and e-commerce logistics. Its competitors include other intelligent manufacturing and logistics system integrators in China and abroad, but the company differentiates itself with comprehensive solutions and extensive project experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 807 million, a 7.41% decrease year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 257 million. Despite the loss, cash flow from operations improved by 65.19%. The company has total assets of about RMB 3 billion and continues to invest in R&D with expenditures exceeding RMB 49 million, representing over 6% of revenue, indicating a focus on long-term growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive intelligent manufacturing and logistics solutions that integrate advanced automation, AI, digital twin, and 5G technologies to enhance production efficiency, accuracy, and flexibility. Its unique value lies in customized, high-end system integration capabilities, strong R&D in core hardware and software, and a broad industry application footprint, enabling clients to achieve digital transformation and green low-carbon operations.
